name: Himejima Komachi
source:
She is the only daughter of the Himejima family, a farming family in Akita, Hokkaido.
Although she is still a young female student, she does not have the flashy charm of today's young people and is rather an old-fashioned beauty.
She has a soft-spoken and refined appearance but also has a strong inner strength.
She has a reliable personality and always plans everything out, but people around her often describe her as being "uptight" and "difficult to get along with," and she wants to change that.
She was chosen as the campaign girl for "Himekomachi," a rice variety developed through repeated development in order to revitalize her region, and with the railway company's permission, she boards the Matsuba train to advertise the product nationwide.
The name Himekomachi comes from Komachi herself, and although she is embarrassed about it, she has a strong love for the product and is proud to be a resident of Akita Prefecture.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20121129135808/http://www.turumiku.jp/matsuba/Komachi.html]official site[/url]]
